**Fixes**
- Jaguar CD games no longer go to a black screen when the console BIOS has been chosen in the Jaguar CD BIOS slot. JagDroid now checks BIOS files when you pick them: the console BIOS is 128 KB and the Jaguar CD BIOS is 256 KB, and a file chosen in the wrong slot is moved to the right one. Starting a CD game with the wrong file in the CD slot now explains what to do.

If Battle Morph or another CD game showed a black screen, open Settings > Jaguar CD BIOS and choose the 256 KB CD BIOS file.

**Known issues**
- Graphics glitches in I-War: under investigation.
